title: Turkey Burgers
instructions: Add turkey mince to a large bowl
Add egg, psyllium husk, soy sauce, and all seasonings
Mix thoroughly until well combined
Let mixture rest for 5 minutes to thicken
Form into 2 equal patties
Preheat air fryer to 190°C
Cook patties for 11–13 minutes, flipping halfway
Serve in burger buns

title: Mediterranean Chicken Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°C
Place chicken and vegetables in a baking dish
Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper
Mix everything evenly
Bake for 25 minutes
Remove from oven, add mozzarella and olives
Bake for an additional 5 minutes until cheese melts

title: Veggie Burger
instructions: Steam or cook vegetables until soft
Mash or finely chop the cooked vegetables
Add egg and breadcrumbs
Season with salt and pepper
Mix until a firm mixture forms
Shape into patties
Bake at 190°C for 20 minutes, flipping halfway

title: Turkey Burger Wrap
instructions: Mix turkey mince, egg, and seasoning in a bowl
Form into patties and cook in a pan for 6–8 minutes per side
Warm wraps slightly
Add lettuce, tomato, and cooked patties to wraps
Roll and serve

title: Veggie Burger Wrap
instructions: Cook veggie patties according to recipe
Warm wraps slightly
Place lettuce and tomato onto wraps
Add cooked patties and sauce
Wrap tightly and serve

title: Creamy Mushroom & Spinach Whole Wheat Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions
Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté garlic
Add mushrooms and cook until soft
Add spinach and cook until wilted
Stir in skyr and mix until creamy
Combine with drained pasta
Season and serve

title: Fillet Steak with Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C
Cut potatoes into wedges and season with half the oil, salt, and pepper
Bake potatoes for 35–40 minutes
Season steak with salt and pepper
Heat a pan and cook steak to desired doneness
Rest steak for 5 minutes and serve with potatoes

title: Fillet Steak with Mushrooms
instructions: Season steak with salt and pepper
Heat pan with olive oil and cook steak to desired doneness
Remove steak and let rest
In the same pan, add butter and cook mushrooms until browned
Serve steak topped with mushrooms

title: Creamy Chicken and Broccoli Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions
Cook chicken in a pan until fully done, then slice
Steam broccoli until tender
Combine skyr with a little pasta water to create a sauce
Mix pasta, chicken, broccoli, and sauce together
Season and serve

title: Fluffy Keto Buns
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C
Mix all ingredients into a dough
Divide into 6 equal portions and shape into buns
Place on baking tray
Bake for 20–25 minutes until golden
Cool before serving

title: Keto Bread Rolls
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C
Mix all ingredients into a dough
Shape into rolls
Bake for 20–25 minutes until firm and golden
Allow to cool before slicing

title: Sandwich Bread
instructions: Mix flour, yeast, salt, and water to form dough
Knead for 10 minutes
Let dough rise for 1 hour
Shape into loaf
Bake at 180°C for 30–35 minutes

title: Heart Healthy Bean Oat Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C
Blend beans until completely smooth
Add eggs, honey, vanilla, and olive oil and blend again
Mix in oat flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt
Fold in chopped dark chocolate
Pour into lined baking tin
Bake for 25–35 minutes
Allow to cool fully before slicing
